prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kejōrō, the Japanese courtesan-like yokai whose face is hidden by hair.
ANATOMY: ONE adult woman-like figure, one head completely engulfed by an enormous thick curtain of long rough BLACK HAIR, every part of face totally obscured: NO eyes, mouth, nose or blank skin visible. Do not reveal whether a face exists. TWO arms and TWO legs beneath fully opaque layered dark plum and antique-gold Edo-style robe, plain tied obi, high closed collar, no cleavage [kejoro-c02,kejoro-c06].
MOMENT: Turn sharply around a dark corridor corner and bend toward viewer as though suddenly encountering them; one hand grips timber doorpost, the other pulls robe hem clear of step. Hair swings forward into lens, outer strands lifted by ordinary corridor draft, whole hidden-face head fills upper foreground. Not calmly standing.
POWER: no documented visible power; menace comes only from impenetrable hair and confrontational movement, no floating hair tentacles, spell or aura.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle, hair-shrouded head and hunched shoulder dominate square, normal human size through tight framing; no invented giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low amber lantern OFF FRAME rakes shiny coarse hair and layered cloth, deep walnut shadows, slight ordinary indoor dust.
SURFACE: tangled coarse black hair, worn opaque silk robe, old wood doorpost and floor.
SETTING: editorial narrow Edo-style interior passage, no specific location asserted.
MOOD: profoundly uncanny sudden close encounter, never ordinary relaxed woman, cute, erotic, glamour portrait or decorative pose. Features remain completely hidden.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Premium painterly brushwork, dark warm walnut and antique gold palette, square composition.
